## Issues affected

## Checklist

<!-- List what this pull request finishes, each item ticked. Work it does not finish is not listed here: it lives in its own issue. -->

## Testing

<!-- What was run and what came out: commands, tests added or changed, results as counts or pass/fail. A `Fix` pull request adds a line `Failed first:` naming the test that failed before the fix and passes after (or `Failed first: none (reason)`). -->

## Screenshots

- **Before:** ...
- **After:** ...

## AI use

<!-- Who wrote the work in this pull request's commits, not who opened the pull request. -->

- **Commits written by:** <!-- a person / an AI / an AI, edited by a person / a person, with AI help -->
- **Model:** <!-- the model that wrote them; n/a when a person did -->
